environment.cpu: Snapdragon(R) X - X126100 - Qualcomm(R) Oryon(TM) CPU

scenario.description: Two clients in one session. Every 2 s: one student message, one volunteer message, alternating stroke chunks of 30 points, and a latency ping from each client.

payload.note: Application event frames only. Excludes WebSocket handshake, HTTP lesson download, TLS and TCP overhead, so real wire traffic is higher.

limitations: Loopback only: no real mobile network was used, so these numbers do not describe a 2G/EDGE link.
Both clients ran on the same machine as the server.
No OS-level network shaping or DevTools throttling was applied to this run.
Payload figures exclude per-frame WebSocket and TCP overhead.
